network.title: Network
network.peerOn: Reaches other devices that also have it on.
network.peerOff: Off: internet only, plus any device pairs.

pairs.title: Device pairs
pairs.description: A pair lets two devices reach each other even when device-to-device access is off.
pairs.directionHint: One way: only the first device starts connections; the other only answers. Starting connections to a device that shares local networks also reaches them.

networks.title: Local networks
networks.description: Share private networks behind {{name}}, such as a home network, with devices that reach it.
networks.label: Networks
networks.hint: One private IPv4 network per line, /20 or smaller. Leave empty to stop sharing.
networks.invalid: Not a private IPv4 network of /20 or smaller: {{networks}}
networks.hostBits: {{network}} isn’t the start of its network. Use {{canonical}}.
networks.inactive: Not routed now, because the VPS reaches these through another network: {{networks}}
networks.linux: {{name}} must run SirinVPN on Linux with IPv4 forwarding on:

ports.title: Port forwarding
ports.none: No ports forwarded to this device.
ports.exposure: Anyone on the internet can reach a forwarded service.
ports.publicPortLow: Use a port from 1024 to 65535. Lower ports are reserved.
ports.used: {max, plural, one {{{count}} of # server port in use} other {{{count}} of # server ports in use}}

ports.visitorAddress: The service sees visitors as <address>{{address}}</address>, not their real IP.

policy.title: Limits and permissions
policy.deviceLimitHint: Leave empty for no limit. Remove extra devices before lowering it.
policy.expiresHint: Your local time. Leave empty to never end.
policy.expiresPast: This time has passed. They lose access as soon as you save.

permission.deviceToDevice: Change device-to-device access and pairs for their devices
permission.portForwards: Open public internet ports to their devices

hours.title: Weekly hours
hours.allWeek: Access is allowed at any time.
hours.localTime: In your time zone ({{zone}}). Daylight saving changes can shift them by an hour.
hours.inexact: Some saved times don’t start on the hour. Editing the grid rounds them to whole hours.

whose.title: Whose device is it?
whose.description: Each device belongs to one person.
whose.mineHint: Another phone or computer of yours.
whose.personHint: Adds a device to a person on this server.
whose.newHint: Adds a person with their first device.

new.name: Their name
new.nameHint: Shown to everyone who manages this server.
new.nameHintFixed: This server can’t let them choose their own name when joining. Shown to everyone who manages this server.
new.several: Several new people will use this code
new.peopleHint: Each person names themselves when joining and becomes a Member.
new.peopleInvalid: Enter a whole number from 2 to 100.
new.nameHintRename: Shown to everyone who manages this server. You can rename them later.

connect.title: How will it connect?
connect.appHint: Recommended. The device gets a join code and creates its own keys.
connect.wireguardHint: Advanced. For iPhone, iPad, Mac or a router. Direct UDP only; it can’t manage the server.

add.deviceNameFixed: This server can’t let them name it when joining. Anyone who manages the server can rename it later.
add.usesHint: Each device joins with its own keys. Device limits still apply.
add.usesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
add.ownerWarningTitle: Whoever uses this code gets full control of the server.
add.ownerWarning: It adds an Owner device. Share it only with yourself, privately.
add.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the code. Select it and copy it manually.
add.copyFailedAndroid: Couldn’t copy the code. Use View or share join code instead.

closeUnshared.title: Close without sharing the code?
closeUnshared.message: It can’t be shown again. If you haven’t copied, scanned or shared it, cancel it under Waiting to join and add the device again.

code.instructionSelf: On your other device, open SirinVPN, choose Use a join code, then scan this QR code or paste the code.
code.instructionSelfAndroid: On your other device, open SirinVPN, choose Use a join code, then scan or paste the code you share from here.
code.instructionPerson: Send this privately to {{name}}. They open SirinVPN, choose Use a join code, and scan or paste it.
code.instructionSeveral: Send this privately to the people joining. Each opens SirinVPN, chooses Use a join code, and scans or pastes it.
code.instructionNew: Send this privately to the person joining. They open SirinVPN, choose Use a join code, scan or paste it, and choose their own name.
code.once: This code is shown only once
code.secret: Anyone with it can join until it’s used, cancelled or expires on {{date}}.

wireguard.instruction: On the device, open the WireGuard app and scan this QR code, or import the saved file.
wireguard.secret: This QR code and file hold the device’s private key. Anyone who has them can use this VPN. Delete the file after importing it.
wireguard.limits: A WireGuard device connects over Direct UDP only and can’t manage the server or follow address changes.
wireguard.fileHint: Optional. Save a .conf file for a router or for importing later.

state.waiting: Waiting for the device to join…
state.expired: The code expired before anyone used it.
state.ended: The code is no longer waiting: it was used or cancelled.

share.qrNote: Scan this instead of copying the code.

owner.title: Make {{name}} the Owner
owner.effect: {{name}} gets full control of the server. You become an Admin, and this cannot be undone from here.
owner.wireguardExcluded: WireGuard devices can’t manage the server, so they aren’t listed.

removeDevice.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDevice.message: Its keys are revoked and its VPN and management access stop at once. It needs a new join code to come back.

removeThis.title: Remove this device?
removeThis.message: This app loses access to {{server}} at once. Getting back needs a new join code from another device.

removePerson.title: Remove {{name}}?
removePerson.message: Deletes {{name}}, {{devices}}, {{forwards}}, {{pairs}} and {{codes}}. This can’t be undone.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.message: {count, plural, one {# device loses access until you resume them. Waiting join codes and key changes are cancelled.} other {# devices lose access until you resume them. Waiting join codes and key changes are cancelled.}}

resume.title: Resume {{name}}?
resume.message: Their devices regain access with saved settings. Cancelled join codes aren’t restored.

role.title: Make {{name}} {{role}}?
role.toAdmin: They can add people and manage Members.
role.toMember: They keep their devices but manage nothing unless given permissions.
role.toAdminCancels: {count, plural, one {They can add people and manage Members. # waiting join code is cancelled first.} other {They can add people and manage Members. # waiting join codes are cancelled first.}}
role.toMemberCancels: {count, plural, one {They keep their devices but manage nothing unless given permissions. # waiting join code is cancelled first.} other {They keep their devices but manage nothing unless given permissions. # waiting join codes are cancelled first.}}

limits.title: Save limits for {{name}}?
limits.message: {count, plural, one {# waiting join code for or by them is cancelled.} other {# waiting join codes for or by them are cancelled.}}

makeOwner.title: Make {{name}} the Owner?
makeOwner.message: {{device}} ({{fingerprint}}) and their other SirinVPN devices get full control. This device becomes an Admin device.

cancelCode.title: Cancel “{{name}}”?
cancelCode.message: The code stops working at once. Devices that already joined keep their access.

openPort.title: Open public port {{publicPort}}?
openPort.message: {{protocol}} port {{publicPort}} will forward to {{device}}, port {{devicePort}}. Anyone on the internet can try to reach it.

closePort.title: Close {{protocol}} port {{publicPort}}?
closePort.message: Connections through it stop at once.

removePair.title: Remove this pair from {{name}}?
removePair.message: The two devices can no longer reach each other unless both have device-to-device access on.

notice.abandoned: The change wasn’t sent: the connection to the server changed. Try again.
notice.ownerChanged: {{name}} is now the Owner. This device is an Admin device.

rejected.expired: This join code has expired. Ask for a new one.
rejected.used: This join code was already used or was cancelled. Ask for a new one.
rejected.invalid: This isn’t a valid join code. Check that you copied all of it, or ask for a new one.

join.ownerDevice: Adds this device to {{name}}, the Owner.
join.ownerPower: Owner devices have full control of the server, every person and every device. Join only if you expected this.
join.personNameHint: Shown to whoever manages this server.
join.deviceNameHint: For example, the phone or computer’s model. You can rename it later.
join.renameLater: It can be renamed later in Devices.
